usedFor: Method CRM holds customers and leads, and “New Contact Created” starts a template as contacts are added or updated.

bestTemplate.name: “New Deal Won” in Teamgate, then “Create Activity” in Method CRM
bestTemplate.why: A won deal gets an activity with dates and an assigned user, so the follow-up has an owner.

watchOut: “New Contact Created” in Method CRM is polling and also returns updated contacts, so expect repeats.
